name: hud_ui_mgr_enable_hud
description: HudUiMgr::EnableHud enables the HUD container and current layout, refreshes objective visibility, sets the alternate clip source rect, enables alternate clipping, and returns the previous enabled state.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x410e90 validates returning the previous g_HudUiMgr.enabled value, setting the HUD container enabled, calling the current layout Enable slot, calling HudUiMgrObjective::Update, setting zClipAlt source rect from g_HudUiMgrSensorBlock.sensorPiVSrcRect, and setting gAltClipPassEnabled to 1.

The native smoke verifies previous-state return, g_HudUiMgr.enabled update, layout enable dispatch, objective widget visibility through HudUiMgrObjective::Update, clip-source left/top/width/height updates, and alternate clip pass enablement.
